auditRole: Separate fresh name-comparison audit only; no claim of independent-provider geometry confirmation. The independent Szombathely geometry review is a separate artifact.
scope: All 89 currently importer-accepted primary neighbourhood features from the pinned 20-dataset manual-source-registry snapshot; only existing primary names, no inferred/planning/local-area promotion.

registrySnapshot.selectionProcedure: Exact repository loadManualSources + collectManualCandidates using validateGeometry and canonical dist/data/settlements.json, then boundaryKind=neighbourhood AND canonicalNameIsNeighborhood=true.

source.method: Official statutory PDF filled-vector path extraction; affine georeferencing in EOV(EPSG:23700) against the current Tata municipal boundary; transformed to WGS84. No buffer, residential-extent inference, artificial closing chord, clipping, or arbitrary polygon generation.
source.license: ODbL-1.0 (OSM-derived georeferencing); official statutory boundary facts
source.processing: Source-based construction occurred in the cited converter; catalogue import preserves its coordinates without repair or invented closing edges.

currentPlaceNodes.selection: All archived named place=suburb|quarter|neighbourhood nodes nationally; not all place=village/hamlet/city or all named natural features.

originalPbf.provider: OpenStreetMap via Geofabrik Hungary country extract

method.normalization: NFKC Unicode normalization, casefold, retain all alphanumeric codepoints and discard punctuation/separators. Hungarian accents and every word, digit and Roman numeral remain. Compare the entire resulting label, in the same canonical municipality only.
method.explicitAliasRule: Only the two individually cited name-equivalence records below; no inferred semantic rename from token similarity.

aliases.semanticScope: Name alternative only; does not establish equivalence of old Szentpál and modern Tabán whole footprints.

method.spatialPointInsideOutsideRole: diagnostic only, never name selection, whole-footprint verification, or georeferencing correction
method.providerIndependence: The contemporary name objects are third-party OSM observations from 2026, but OSM is also a provider of many geometry controls/roads. This is not an independent provider confirmation of source geometry.
method.currentMeans: Present in the 2026-11-12 OSM snapshot or an explicitly dated 2026 web usage. Older name-equivalence evidence may link a current label; it does not independently date current usage.
